label: Xiaomi 14 smartphone
description: Xiaomi 14 — 6.36-inch Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 flagship with Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) and 5G sub-6 GHz; USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 with Ethernet over dock.
notes: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz, 320 MHz, MLO). Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz only, no mmWave; LTE Cat 24 fallback. USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 with DisplayPort alt mode and Ethernet adapter support (usb0). HyperOS; supports Wi-Fi 7 only when the AP advertises 802.11be and MLO.
